items.title: Teladoc unveils remote monitoring, ambient AI features
items.excerpt: The company has integrated artificial intelligence scribing and camera-based vitals monitoring into its virtual care platform for hospitals as it works to recover from significant financial setbacks.

items.title: RFK Jr.'s Embrace of AI Confounds Some MAHA Allies and Medical Experts
items.excerpt: At a MAHA summit with AI and Silicon Valley executives, HHS Secretary Kennedy said AI would let Americans "fact check their own medical advice," unsettling some allies and medical experts.

items.title: Multi-agent AI for liver disease guideline development and maintenance: a proof-of-concept study
items.excerpt: Here the authors develop multi-agent AI that acts like a digital committee to review evidence and flag potential guideline updates. In liver disease benchmarks, it replicated expert consensus and cut early-career clinicians’ guideline errors by half.

items.excerpt: This exploratory, multicenter, randomized, rater-blinded, multi-arm comparative trial aimed to evaluate the feasibility and exploratory clinical signals of an AI-facilitated telerehabilitation system across different intervention durations in early-stage Parkinson’s disease (PD). items.title: FDA clears AI tool for pediatric bone age assessments
items.excerpt: Bone age assessments are commonly used to evaluate whether a child's skeletal development is consistent with their chronological age.

items.title: Widespread AI adoption in private practice produces measurable efficiency gains
items.excerpt: European imaging experts recently conducted an expansive study, involving 10 different AI tools from seven separate vendors, implemented across 20 centers staffed by 58 rads.

items.title: Radiology AI authorizations rise 42% as regulatory landscape evolves
items.excerpt: A new analysis of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s artificial intelligence-enabled medical device database details how the technology’s regulatory standing has changed in recent years.

items.title: FDA spells out 2027 AI guidance plans
items.excerpt: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: New AI guidances expected from the the FDA in 2027, Utah expanding its AI sandbox, and more.

items.excerpt: “We can document honestly and still wind up inflating hospital bills,” writes a frustrated doctor.

items.title: Riverain's ClearRead Chest AI comes to RapidAI platform
items.excerpt: ClearRead Chest, which analyzes chest CT and x-rays to help radiologists detect pulmonary nodules, pneumothoraces and coronary artery calcification, is now available on the RapidAI platform.

items.title: Clairity expands access to AI breast cancer risk tool via Everlywell
items.excerpt: Clairity Breast, FDA De Novo-authorized in 2025, predicts a woman's five-year breast cancer risk from a single screening mammogram; an Everlywell partnership broadens U.S. availability beyond two imaging sites.

items.title: n1.care launches AI clinical intelligence platform
items.excerpt: n1.care is rolling out an AI platform that merges imaging, lab results, genetics and records from multiple providers into one longitudinal view; licensed clinicians review and approve each report before patients see it.

items.title: 동국대일산병원, AI 활용 ‘개인에서 조직으로’… AX 전환 시동
items.excerpt: 동국대일산병원이 개별 직원 중심의 인공지능(AI) 활용을 병원 조직 차원의 AI 전환(AX·AI Transformation)으로 확대한다.동국대일산병원은 지난 6일 병원 4층 중강당에서 ‘AI 챌린지 시상식’과 ‘AI TFT(Task Force Team) 위원회 위촉장 전달식’을 개최했다.이번 행사는 AI를 특정 부서나 일부 직원의 활용에 그치지 않고 병원 전체의 업무 역량으로 확산하기 위해 진행됐다.
